question: Does the new QWZ/carry/probe report hold, and does the full operator-valued spinor transition measure give exact projected controlled dynamics?
summary_de: Die QWZ-Stromtabelle und Sektorenergien sind reproduziert; der Fourier-Rest O_W(N^-3) ist ausgeschrieben. Das volle operatorwertige Uebergangsmass bestimmt bei ungeraden beschraenkten Spinorproben die exakte reduzierte Antwort samt Ladungs-Carry, aber keinen mikroskopischen Feldursprung.
kills: The displayed low-momentum current table can be used without specifying its momentum window
A charge-equivariant limit of the bare neutral flux string is already a half-charged field
A scalar vacuum transition measure determines the off-diagonal retained carry response
Quadratic probe self-energy implies only quadratic response or eigenvalue shifts
leaves_open: Microscopic charged spinor, cocycle and one-edge source limit
Native eight-channel source and actual C/J field action
Uniform removal of unbounded current control cutoff
Common3+1D source, full complement ground theorem and complete TFPT solution
